```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggtext)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggpattern)
library(data.table)
library(MuMIn)
library(scales)
library(performance)

plot_theme<-theme_classic()+
  theme(
    strip.background=element_blank(),
    strip.text.x=element_text(size=12,
                              hjust=0,
                              face="bold",colour="black"),
    strip.text.y=element_text(size=12,
                              hjust=0,
                              face="bold",colour="black"),
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="transparent"),
    panel.border=element_rect(fill="transparent",color="black",
                              linewidth=0.5),
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="transparent",color=NA),
    legend.background=element_rect(fill="transparent"),
    legend.position="none",
    # legend.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
    legend.text=element_text(size=12),
    # axis.line.x=element_line(linewidth=1,color="black"),
    axis.line.x=element_blank(),
    axis.line.y=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks=element_line(linewidth=0.5,color="black"),
    axis.ticks.length=unit(-0.05,"in"),
    axis.title = element_text(size=12,
                              colour="black",face="bold"),
    axis.text=element_text(size=10,colour="black"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0,hjust=0.5,colour="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black"),
    plot.title=element_text(size=12),
    strip.placement="outside")
  
```

## ANPP
```{r ANPP data}
anpp<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_ANPP_2022-2024.csv")
str(anpp)

anpp.no.na<-anpp%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_22,TRT.2023=TRT_23,C3.GRASSES=C3,Notes=Note.)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(Plot,Year,Clip,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,C3.GRASSES,C4,FORB,ANNUALS,TOTAL.GRASSES,ANPP,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with ANPP NA's
  drop_na(ANPP)%>%
  # create Unique ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste("Plot_",Plot,Clip,sep="-"))
  
str(anpp.no.na)


anpp.22<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2022")
anpp.23<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2023")
anpp.24<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2024")

```

```{r ANPP outlier checks}
#### 2022 ####
dat<-anpp.22
dat$resp<-dat$ANPP

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(Clip),y=resp,color=TRT.2022))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","steelblue4"))+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")

out.plot

ext.22<-dat%>%
  group_by(Clip,TRT.2022)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE)
ext.22

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(Clip)*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=dat)
# performance::check_model(mod.check)

plot(mod.check)
leveneTest(resp~as.factor(Clip)*TRT.2022,data=dat) # fail
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fine

outlierTest(mod.check) # none significant
# view(dat)
dat.22<-dat

#### 2023 ####
dat<-anpp.23%>%
  filter(!Unique_ID %in% c("Plot_-12-Sept_23_clip","Plot_-2-Sept_23_clip","Plot_-31-July_23"))
dat$resp<-dat$ANPP

anpp.23.avs<-dat%>%
  group_by(Year,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(resp),
    sd = sd(resp),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(Clip),y=resp,color=interaction(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","sandybrown","lightblue","steelblue4"))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")
  
out.plot

ext.23<-dat%>%
  group_by(Clip,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE)
ext.23

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(Clip)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
# performance::check_model(mod.check)

plot(mod.check)
leveneTest(resp~as.factor(Clip)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # close enough
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fails

outlierTest(mod.check) # outlier @ Plot_-12-Sept_23_clip -- huge (500g/m2) forb skewing ANPP & Plot_-2-Sept_23_clip 230g/m2 forb & Plot_-31-July_23 175g/m2 forb
# view(dat) 
dat.23<-dat

#### 2024 ####
dat<-anpp.24
dat$resp<-dat$ANPP

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(Clip),y=resp,color=interaction(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","sandybrown","lightblue","steelblue4"))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")
  
out.plot

ext.24<-dat%>%
  group_by(Clip,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE)
ext.24

mod.check<-lm(resp~TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat)
# performance::check_model(mod.check)

plot(mod.check,1)
leveneTest(resp~TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # fine
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fine

outlierTest(mod.check) # no significant outliers
# view(dat) 
dat.24<-dat
```

```{r ANPP end of season}
#### 2022 ####
end.22<-subset(dat.22,Clip=="Sept_22_clip")
str(end.22) # 40 observations

## T-test
# check normality
ggplot(end.22, aes(x = resp, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(end.22$resp[end.22$TRT.2022 == "amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(end.22$resp[end.22$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

# if normal, use t.test, if not use transformations or wilcox.test
t.test(resp~TRT.2022,data=end.22) # p < 0.0001

## plot
end.plot.avs.22<-end.22%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(resp),
    sd = sd(resp),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

fi.name<-"fig_exports/ANPP/No_Outliers/New/SGS_EW_2022_ANPP_end.pdf"
y.lab<-expression(paste(bold("ANPP (g m"^"-2"*")")))
ylims=c(0,160)
p.val="p < 0.0001"
text.y=85

end.22.plot<-ggplot(data=end.plot.avs.22,aes(x=TRT.2022,y=av,color=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2022))+
  labs(title=expression(bold("2022")),y=y.lab,x=NULL)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=ylims,expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("amb"="Amb.\nDrought","wet"="Exp.\nWet"),
                   # expand=expansion(0.85)
                   )+
  geom_col_pattern(width=0.75,
                   aes(pattern=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2022,color=TRT.2022),
                   pattern_color="white",
                   pattern_fill=NA,
                   pattern_density=0.2,
                   pattern_spacing=0.04,
                   pattern_alpha=0.75,
                   pattern_aspect_ratio=0.1,
                   )+
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=c("#F8D48C","#B3BEDE"))+
  scale_pattern_manual(values=c("stripe",NA))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=av-SE,ymax=av+SE),
                position=position_dodge(0.75),
                width=0.1,linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  scale_color_manual(name=NULL,
                     values=c("#F4B942","#4059AD"))+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9))+
  geom_text(data=subset(gs.plot.avs.22,TRT.2022=="amb"),
            label=p.val,
            x=1.5,y=text.y,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
  
end.22.plot

# ggsave(end.22.plot,filename=fi.name,height=3,width=3)

#### 2023 ####
end.23<-subset(dat.23,Clip=="Sept_23_clip")
str(end.23) # 38 observations

#### combined complete ANOVA ####
end.23.comb.mod<-lm(resp ~ TRT.2022*TRT.2023, data=end.23)
plot(end.23.comb.mod,1)
qqnorm(resid(end.23.comb.mod));qqline(resid(end.23.comb.mod))

Anova(end.23.comb.mod,type=3) # interaction NOT significant
pairs(emmeans(end.23.comb.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|TRT.2023))
p.23.amb<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.7828 (t ratio = -0.278, df = 34), interaction main effect n.s."
p.23.wet<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.6420 (t ratio = -0.469, df = 34), interaction main effect n.s."

end.23.comb.mod.red<-lm(resp~TRT.2023,data=end.23)
Anova(end.23.comb.mod.red,type=3)
step(end.23.comb.mod)

#### <- wet 2023 ####
wet.end.23<-subset(end.23,TRT.2023=="wet")
str(wet.end.23) # 19 observations

## T-test
# check normality
ggplot(wet.end.23, aes(x = resp, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(wet.end.23$resp[wet.end.23$TRT.2022 == "amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(wet.end.23$resp[wet.end.23$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

t.test(resp ~ TRT.2022, data = wet.end.23) # p = 0.6743

#### <- amb 2023 ####
amb.end.23<-subset(end.23,TRT.2023=="amb")
str(amb.end.23) # 19 observations

## T-test
# check normality
ggplot(amb.end.23, aes(x = resp, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(amb.end.23$resp[amb.end.23$TRT.2022 == "amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(amb.end.23$resp[amb.end.23$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

t.test(resp ~ TRT.2022, data = amb.end.23) # p = 0.7594

## plot
wet.end.plot.avs.23<-wet.end.23%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(resp),
    sd = sd(resp),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

amb.end.plot.avs.23<-amb.end.23%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(resp),
    sd = sd(resp),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

end.plot.avs.23<-rbind(wet.end.plot.avs.23,amb.end.plot.avs.23)

        )+

  geom_text(data=subset(end.plot.avs.23,

            label=p.val.wet,
            x=1.5,y=text.y.wet,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+

                        TRT.2022=="amb"),
            aes(label=TRT.2023,
            x=0.75,y=145),
            hjust=0,

            size=10/.pt,
            fontface="bold",
            inherit.aes=FALSE)+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
  
end.23.plot
```

## PRS
```{r PRS data}
prs.dat<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_PRS.csv")
str(prs.dat) # 600 observations

prs.no.na<-prs.dat%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_2022,TRT.2023=TRT_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(Plot,Burial,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,Nutrient,rate,below_MDL,Unique_ID,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with NA's & below MDL
  drop_na(rate)%>%
  filter(below_MDL == "no")
  
str(prs.no.na) # 487 observations

prs.no3<-subset(prs.no.na,Nutrient=="NO3_N")
str(prs.no3) # 40 observations
```

```{r PRS outlier check}
dat<-prs.no3

dat$resp<-dat$rate
str(dat)

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(Burial),y=resp,color=interaction(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","sandybrown","lightblue","steelblue4"))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")
  
out.plot

ext.23<-dat%>%
  group_by(Burial,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE)
ext.23

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(Burial)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
# performance::check_model(mod.check)

plot(mod.check)
leveneTest(resp~as.factor(Burial)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # 0.01
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fine

outlierTest(mod.check) # no significant outliers

dat.23<-dat
```

```{r PRS analysis}
early.late.23.plot<-ggplot(data=gr_dat,aes(x=TRT.2022,y=av,fill=TRT.2023))+
  facet_wrap(factor(period, levels = c("early-mid","mid-late"),
                     labels = facet.labs) ~.)+
  labs(title=expression(bold("2023")),
       y=y.lab,x=NULL)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=ylims,expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL),oob=scales::squish)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("amb"="2022\nDrought","wet"="2022\nWet"),
                   # expand=expansion(0.85)
                   )+
  geom_col_pattern(width=0.75,
                   aes(pattern=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2023),
                   pattern_color="white",
                   pattern_fill=NA,
                   pattern_density=0.2,
                   pattern_spacing=0.04,
                   pattern_alpha=0.75,
                   pattern_aspect_ratio=0.1,
                   color="black"
                   )+
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=fill.col
                    # values=c("#F4B942")
                    )+
  scale_pattern_manual(values=c("stripe",NA))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=av-SE,ymax=av+SE),
                position=position_dodge(0.75),
                width=0.1,linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  geom_text(data=subset(gr_dat,period == "early-mid" & TRT.2022 == "amb"),
            label=p.val.early,
            x=1.5,y=text.y.early,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+
  geom_text(data=subset(gr_dat,period == "mid-late" & TRT.2022 == "amb"),
            label=p.val.late,
            x=1.5,y=text.y.late,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9),
        # strip.text.x=element_blank(),
        strip.text.x=element_text(size=10,
                              hjust=0,
                              # vjust=-6.75,
                              # vjust=-0.8,
                              face="bold",
                              colour="black")
        )+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
  


early.late.23.plot

# ggsave(early.late.23.plot,filename=fi.name,height=3,width=3)

#### across growing season ####
prs.all<-lmer(log(resp)~TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=periods.23)
plot(prs.all)
qqnorm(resid(prs.all));qqline(resid(prs.all))
shapiro.test(resid(prs.all)) # OK
leveneTest(log(resp)~TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=periods.23) # OK

anova(prs.all,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

prs.all.reduced<-lmer(log(resp)~TRT.2022+TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=periods.23)
shapiro.test(resid(prs.all.reduced)) # OK

anova(prs.all.reduced,ddf="Kenward-Roger")
```
